implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosure is mandatory within two trading days of crossing the 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 40%, 50% or 55% threshold in listed entity shareholding; this filing signals either Kirloskar family consolidation, an open offer trigger event, or a material change in control position requiring market transparency.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure within two trading days of acquisition crossing prescribed thresholds (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 55%); sets out acquirer identity, mode, consideration, and triggering event.
Defines 'acquirer', 'shares', and 'voting rights'; clarifies scope of indirect/beneficial acquisition.
Open offer requirements triggered if acquisition results in holding of 25% or more (or increase in holding by 2% in any financial year post-acquisition at 25%).
Provides statutory foundation for SEBI to make takeover regulations; applies to all listed companies.
Requires material related-party transactions and board approvals for significant acquisition transactions.
Disclosures by directors regarding shareholding and material interests; applies to promoter acquisitions.
Exemptions and relaxations available for certain categories (e.g., intra-group transfers, acquisitions by acquirer already holding >50%).

headline: Sanjay Kirloskar files SEBI Takeover Regulation disclosure under Reg 31(4)
sum: Sanjay Kirloskar has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4), flagging a substantial acquisition in or change to his shareholding in Kirloskar Industries Limited.
detail: Sanjay Kirloskar, a key member of the Kirloskar group promoter family, has submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation mandates disclosure of acquisitions that cross prescribed shareholding thresholds. The filing triggers statutory obligations toward public shareholders and market participants. The exact quantum of shares acquired, purchase price, and triggering threshold are contained in the full disclosure document.
